name: – Michael Gahler – After § 33 – Am 57
title: REPORT on the 2025 Commission report on Ukraine
part_text: 33a. Notes that 4.33 million people fleeing Ukraine were under temporary protection in the EU in November 2025; welcomes the Commission announcement of 26 June 2026 to the effect that temporary protection should not, as a rule, be granted to newly arriving Ukrainian nationals who are not authorised to leave Ukraine in view of their military obligations; calls on Ukrainian men of military age to return to Ukraine; encourages Member States to adapt their asylum, reception and temporary protection policies accordingly;
